title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU-HONDURAS Private Sector Partnership for Sustainable Investments

description.narrative: The Action aims to strengthen sustainable European and Honduran private sector engagement for the implementation of the Global Gateway Investment Agenda (GGIA) in Honduras. The main objective of the Action is to catalyze transformative, sustainable economic development in Honduras through structured partnerships between European and Honduran stakeholders¿enhancing the business environment, facilitating sustainable investment and technology transfer, and deepening trade and skills cooperation¿by aligning national efforts with European standards. The Action aims to increase investor confidence by improving regulatory and institutional frameworks, promote sustainable and impact-driven investments through EU-Honduras business alliances, and foster long-term collaboration between Business Intermediary Organizations (BIOs) and Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions to build a competitive, climate-resilient, green and circular economy. In turn, this will catalyze additional funding for the GGIA in the country in the form of loans, asset participation, guarantees and other fund investments by partnering with companies, international financial institutions (IFIs), private impact and environmental, social and governance (ESG) investors. The establishment and development of valuable partnerships between European and Honduras business intermediary organizations (BIOs) and their related development finance institutions will ensure private sector engagement and sustainability of the action.
